```app
// Tetris: arrows move and rotate, space drops; buttons too. Fill lines to score; stack to the top ends it.
state board = [0; 200];   // 10 x 20 well, 0 empty, 1..7 colors
state stack = [0; 200];    // the settled pieces
state shape = [0; 8];      // the falling piece: x,y pairs, relative to px, py
state px = 0;
state py = 0;
state kind = 0;            // 1..7, also its color
state nextk = 0;
state score = 0;
state lines = 0;
state over = false;
saved state best = 0;

fn at(x: int, y: int) -> int { return y * 10 + x; }

fn setshape(k: int) {
  kind = k;
  if k == 1 { shape = [-1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, 0]; }       // I
  else if k == 2 { shape = [-1, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1, 0, 1]; } // O
  else if k == 3 { shape = [-1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1]; }  // T
  else if k == 4 { shape = [0, 0, 1, 0, -1, 1, 0, 1]; }  // S
  else if k == 5 { shape = [-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1]; }  // Z
  else if k == 6 { shape = [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2]; }   // J
  else { shape = [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2]; }             // L
}

fn freecell(x: int, y: int) -> bool {
  if x < 0 || x >= 10 || y < 0 || y >= 20 { return false; }
  return stack[at(x, y)] == 0;
}

fn fits(dx: int, dy: int) -> bool {
  for i in 0..4 {
    if !freecell(px + shape[i * 2] + dx, py + shape[i * 2 + 1] + dy) { return false; }
  }
  return true;
}

fn paint() {
  for i in 0..len(board) { board[i] = stack[i]; }
  if kind > 0 {
    for i in 0..4 { board[at(px + shape[i * 2], py + shape[i * 2 + 1])] = kind; }
  }
}

fn spawn() {
  setshape(nextk);
  nextk = random(7) + 1;
  px = 4;
  py = 0;
  if !fits(0, 0) {
    kind = 0;
    over = true;
    best = max(best, score);
  }
  paint();
}

fn clearlines() {
  let y = 19;
  repeat 20 {
    let full = true;
    for x in 0..10 {
      if stack[at(x, y)] == 0 { full = false; }
    }
    if full {
      remove(stack, at(0, y));
      remove(stack, at(0, y));
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      insert(stack, 0, 0);
      lines += 1;
      score += 10;
    } else { y -= 1; }
  }
}

fn lock() {
  for i in 0..4 { stack[at(px + shape[i * 2], py + shape[i * 2 + 1])] = kind; }
  clearlines();
  spawn();
}

fn fall() {
  if fits(0, 1) { py += 1; } else { lock(); }
  paint();
}

fn shift(dx: int) {
  if fits(dx, 0) { px += dx; paint(); }
}

fn rotate() {
  if kind == 2 { return; }
  let old = [0; 8];
  for i in 0..8 { old[i] = shape[i]; }
  for i in 0..4 { shape[i * 2] = old[i * 2 + 1]; shape[i * 2 + 1] = -old[i * 2]; }
  if !fits(0, 0) {
    if fits(1, 0) { px += 1; }
    else if fits(-1, 0) { px -= 1; }
    else {
      for i in 0..8 { shape[i] = old[i]; }
      return;
    }
  }
  paint();
}

fn drop() {
  repeat 20 {
    if fits(0, 1) { py += 1; score += 1; }
  }
  lock();
}

fn start() {
  for i in 0..len(stack) { stack[i] = 0; }
  score = 0;
  lines = 0;
  over = false;
  nextk = random(7) + 1;
  spawn();
}

every 400 {
  if !over && kind > 0 { fall(); }
}

on key "left" { if !over { shift(-1); } }
on key "right" { if !over { shift(1); } }
on key "up" { if !over { rotate(); } }
on key "down" { if !over { fall(); } }
on key "space" { if !over { drop(); } }

label "Tetris";
label "Score " + score + "   Lines " + lines + "   Best " + best;
grid 10, board;
row {
  button "<" { if !over { shift(-1); } }
  button "Rotate" { if !over { rotate(); } }
  button ">" { if !over { shift(1); } }
}
row {
  button "Drop" { if !over { drop(); } }
  button "Down" { if !over { fall(); } }
}
if over {
  label "Game over";
  button "Start" { start(); }
}
```
